note: The module designs that exist and the element types they carry (OI-HWFIT-01). The one authority: the core's fit check (common/npps-core/src/fit.rs) and the web's helmetInventory.ts read this file. The element ordinals are the firmware's np_elem_type_t (firmware/hub_control/include/np_module_map.h), frozen once written to NVRAM: append only, never renumber; common/lib/moduleDesigns.test.ts fails if the header and this file disagree. Not yet versioned with the hardware version (OI-HWFIT-01 question a).

wireTypes.note: The module design behind each tile type the hub reports in ZONE_MODULE_STATUS (np_zn_module_type_t, np_zone_notify.h): the status carries a type and no element list, so a caller that has only the status asks the core with the type. 1 T1-A and 3 T1-C are NP-HW-HEXTILE-001 §4.2; 4 is the 1170 nm tile. 2 (T1-B) is an inference: its spec is out of scope of that document, so the PBM-plus-dual-electrode combo is assumed (UC-122). A type not listed (absent 0, unknown 255, or any other) carries no element.
